Jsw Steel Limited has informed the Exchange that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company (the "Board") held on September 01 2012, the Board has considered and unanimously approved a 'Composite Scheme of Arrangement and Amalgamation' under Sections 391-394 of the Companies Act 1956 (the "Scheme) among the Company, JSW Ispat Steel Limited ("JSW Ispat"), JSW Building Systems Ltd. ("JSW Building"), Maharashtra Sponge Iron Ltd ("Maharashtra Sponge") and their respective shareholders and creditors relating to the following matters (to be effected in the sequence set forth hereinbelow):  (a) transfer of the 'Kalmeshwar' undertaking of JSW Ispat to Maharashtra Sponge (an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of the Company).  (b) transfer of the 'Vasind' and 'Tarapur' undertaking of the Company to Maharashtra Sponge.  (c) amalgamation of JSW Building (a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company) with the Company.  (d) amalgamation of the JSW Ispat with the Company, pursuant to which the shareholders of the JSW Ispat will be entitled to shares of the Company as under:. (i) The equity shareholders of the JSW Ispat will be entitled to 1 (One) equity share face value Rs. 10/-(Rupees Ten Only) each of the Company for every 72 (Seventy Two) fully paid up equity shares of Rs. 10/-(Rupees Ten Only) each of JSW Ispat held by them ("Share Exchange Ratio"); and  (ii) The preference shareholders of the JSW Ispat will be entitled to 1 (One) fully paid up non-convertible cumulative redeemable preference share of face value Rs 10/-(Rupees Ten Only) each of the Company for every 1 (One) fully paid up cumulative redeemable preference share of face value Rs. 10/-(Rupees Ten Only) each of JSW Ispat held by them.  With this regard Company has also submitted a copy of Press Release dated September 01, 2012 titled " Merger Catapults JSW Steel to Top League in Indian Steel Sector"

Jsw Steel Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 16, 2011, inter alia, has transacted the following : (1) Augmenting Crude Steel Capacity to 12mtpa at Vijayanagar Works : The Board reviewed the progress of the on-going Capital Expenditure programmes and status of tie up of resources. The Rationale for next phase of expansion to 12 MTPA from 10 MTPA at Vijayanagar Works was discussed. Considering the growing demand for steel in India, faster Brownfield expansions at low specific investment cost per tonne, the Board approved to take up Brownfield expansion at the Company's Vijayanagar Works at an estimated cost of Rs. 2,695 crores so as to augment the Crude Steel Capacity to 12 mtpa. The projects are expected to be completed by June 30, 2013. The cost of the project is to be financed by way of cash accruals to the extent of Rs. 945 crores and balance through Debt. (2) Change in Company's Directorate - Mr. Yasushi Kurokawa has been appointed as the Nominee Director of JFE Steel Corporation, Japan on the Board of the Company w.e.f. May 16, 2011 in place of Mr. Shigeru Ogura. Mr. Kurokawa is the Sr. Vice President, Corporate planning Dept-India JSW Project Team, Technical Co-operation Department, Controller Department and Auditing Department of JFE Steel Corporation.

Jsw Steel Limited has informed the Exchange that at the Board meeting held on April 19, 2006, the following decisions were taken :  (1) At the Board meeting held on January 20, 2006, it was proposed to issue securities on a right basis not exceeding a sum of Rs.400 crores (excluding proceeds on warrants, 2 warrants for each share subscribed on rights Basis). In view of the significant interest shown by foreign investors to invest in the steel sector due to recent spurt in prices and promising steel Industry outlook, the Directors have decided to consider a comprehensive plan to raise additional resources by way of GDR/ADR or FCCB, besides rights issue of shares with warrants (Shareholders at the AGM held on June 13, 2005  had approved raising of funds through ADR/GDR/FCCB upto USD 500 million).  (2) The Board approved the sale of 60Mega Watt Power Plant in Tamil Nadu to Southern Iron & Steel Company Ltd as a �Slump sale� at a consideration to be determined by an independent valuer. (3) The Company has decided to participate in a Special purpose Vehicle for setting up a 2 x 250 MW power plant at Toranagallu by way of a Joint Venture with JSW Energy Ltd.  The ratio in the Equity participation between JSW Energy Ltd & JSW Steel shall be 74:26.  The contribution towards the 26% Equity is Rs.124.80 Crores. This participation will ensure the Company of continuous power supply for its enhanced capacity being 3.8 MTPA. (3) It has been decided to Shut down the Hot Rolled Mill at Toranagallu, Karnataka for a period of around 30 days for modernization & Capacity enhancement from 2 MTPA to 2.5 MTPA.  This plant will restart operations in the second half of May 2006.  On re-commissioning the quality of the products will improve due to moderisation of plant and the capacity will also go up.

Jindal Vijayanagar Steel Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on May 09, 2005, considered and approved the acquisition of Euro Ikon Iron & Steel Private Limited ('Euro Ikon'), Euro Coke & Energy Private Limited ('Euro Coke') and JSW power Limited ('JPL') by way of merger under a Scheme of Amalgamation of Euro Ikon, Euro Coke and JPL with Jindal Vijayanagar Steel Limited ('JVSL') and their respective shareholders under Sections 391 to 394 of the Companies Act, 1956. The Appointed Date for the merger is April 1, 2005.  The Company has further informed that pursuant to the Scheme i) Equity shareholders of Euro Ikon will be allotted 1 equity share of JVSL of Rs.10 each in lieu of 16 equity shares of Rs.10/- each held in Euro Ikon. ii) Equity shareholders of Euro Coke will be allotted 1 equity share of JVSL of Rs.10 each in lieu of 19 equity shares of Rs.10/- each held in Euro Coke; and iii) Equity shareholders of JPL will be allotted 1 equity shares of JVSL of Rs.10 each in lieu of 25 equity shares of Rs.10/- each held in JPL. Following implementation of the Scheme & issue of shares as above, the aggregate equity capital of JVSL will increase by a sum of Rs.17,99,28,360/- consisting of 1,79,92,836 equity shares of Rs.10/- each subject to minor changes upon rounding off of fractional entitlements. The Scheme is subject to requisite consent, approval of the requisite majority of the shareholders, lenders, creditors of the Company, Euro Ikon, Euro Coke and JPL, the Bombay High Court, and the permission or approval of any other statutory or regulatory authorities, which by law may be necessary for the implementation of the Scheme.
